ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40% high-intensity white to 60% low-intensity black across the visible ventral surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patch occupying the distal two-thirds of the left lobe; smaller, fragmented white mottling concentrated at the trailing edge and distal tip of the right lobe; solid black pigmentation dominates the medial region and fluke base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 48 degrees; base depth is partially obscured by water splash.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations present along the entire visible trailing edge; amplitude peaks at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edge curve transitioning into acute, slightly recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Six distinct dark circular pixel clusters (diameter 5-15 pixels) localized within the white pigmentation of the left lobe; additional scattered micro-spots on the right lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned, light-grey linear streaks (rake marks) ranging from 20-80 pixels in length, oriented diagonally across the dark central and right-medial fluke surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the central fluke body; irregular minor indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
